system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: deds_generate_otp and deds_cancel_application. Here are my details: my mobile_number is 9876530804, my application_id is DEDS-APP-20000001, my aadhaar_number is 100020007393.

function.name: deds_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for DEDS authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.

function.name: deds_cancel_application
function.description: Cancels a DEDS application. Only possible when application_status is 'submitted' or 'under_review'. Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify loans. Fails if application is already approved, rejected, or project started.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
